Name: ChestItemFinder
Author: cynthiazhao0411
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
ChestItemFinder helps you find which chest holds the item you're looking for. Type one console command and every chest containing that item pulses yellow in the world, with an on-screen message telling you how many were found and in which locations. Built for late-game farms where you have too many chests to remember what's in each one.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download the zip and extract the ChestItemFinder folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Load a save, open the SMAPI console window, and type: find_item <item name>
  Example: find_item Ancient Fruit

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Searches every chest in every location, including Ginger Island
- Matches both localized display names and internal English names, so it works in any game language
- Case-insensitive partial matching (e.g. "gem" finds all gem items)
- Matching chests pulse yellow in the world
- On-screen message shows how many chests were found and where
- Highlights clear automatically after you open a chest

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or later
